cards.claim: Muon optimizers improve neural-network training by replacing ill-conditioned momentum updates with approximately semi-orthogonal updates
cards.conditions: General claim; no specific model, data, budget, or hardware specified
cards.quote: Muon optimizers improve neural-network training by replacing ill-conditioned momentum updates with approximately semi-orthogonal updates.

cards.claim: Cubic Newton-Schulz schedule reduces dominant matrix multiplications compared to quintic variant
cards.conditions: Implementation comparison; applies to Muon orthogonalization strategies
cards.effect: 10 matrix multiplications (cubic) vs 15 (quintic); 33% reduction in primary computational cost
cards.quote: The resulting five-step cubic construction uses ten dominant matrix multiplications, compared with fifteen for five quintic Newton--Schulz iterations.

cards.claim: Training quality is not monotonically governed by polar-decomposition accuracy; different orthogonalization methods reach nearly indistinguishable final loss
cards.conditions: GPT-2 Small; methods tested: truncated Polar Express, Muon-Jordan, cubic Newton-Schulz, explicit FP32 SVD
cards.effect: Nearly indistinguishable final loss across methods
cards.evidence: Empirical experiments on language model training
cards.quote: we find that training quality is not governed monotonically by polar-decomposition accuracy: truncated Polar Express, Muon-Jordan, cubic Newton--Schulz, and an explicit FP32 SVD polar factor can reach nearly indistinguishable final loss on GPT-2 Small

cards.claim: Cubic5 orthogonalization matches Muon-Jordan quintic on large models with minimal validation loss difference
cards.effect: Within ~10^−3 validation loss of quintic variant
cards.quote: cubic5 matches the Muon-Jordan quintic update within about $10^{-3}$ validation loss on hybrid MoE/Mamba models with one billion to four billion parameters.

cards.claim: Cubic5 is a practical, low-cost Muon orthogonalization variant with empirical training-quality parity
cards.conditions: Across synthetic diagnostics, NanoGPT ablations, and hybrid MoE/Mamba training (1B–4B models)
cards.effect: Training-quality parity achieved with lower per-step overhead
cards.evidence: Empirical evidence from diagnostic and training experiments
cards.quote: These results support cubic5 as a practical low-cost Muon orthogonalization variant, with empirical evidence of training-quality parity in the settings tested.
